page.overview:
Who is Berix?

Berix was a Human male who served in the Galactic Republic's Military during the Galactic War. He was a member of the Deadeyes, a Republic Army sniper squad. When the Deadeyes allowed themselves to be captured by the Imperials, he and some of his fellow Deadeyes were sent to a labor camp in Hoth. Havoc Squad eventually rescued him.
